resources.string: The selected service has not given any sound yet.
No sound: CDR codes its sound with DRA+, and OnAir does not include a DRA+ decoder (its patent and licence status is unclear). The services, signal information and data work without it.
No sound: the DRA+ add-on cannot be used: %1$s

To get sound, build the DRA+ add-on for Android on a computer with the Android NDK (OnAir source, tools/addons/dra; the steps are in docs/CODECS.md, "DRA+ on Android"), copy libonair_dra.so to the phone and tap Import below.
The file is copied into OnAir\'s own folder. A removed add-on stays loaded until the app is closed.
The add-on could not be imported: %1$s
No services yet: they appear once the multiplex is decoded.
This build has no receiver library, so there is no TV.
Waiting for the transport stream. Start the receiver on a TV channel; the services appear once it locks.
The stream arrives, but no service list yet (PAT, PMT and SDT come within a few seconds).

Picture and sound are decoded by this phone\'s own decoders (Android MediaCodec). OnAir ships no codec: a format the phone has no decoder for stays silent or dark, and the screen says which. Wideband TV demodulation is heavy for a phone: expect it to get warm, drain the battery quickly and, on slower phones, not keep up.
